newsitem.title: USA: Motorola signs $53 million wireless contract.
newsitem.headline: Motorola signs $53 million wireless contract.

text.p: Motorola Inc. said Tuesday it has signed a $53 million contract with Bell Atlantic NYNEX Mobile to upgrade the company's wireless communications network in Phoenix, Ariz. and Charlotte, N.C..

The contract includes the installation of code division multiple access technology, which virtually eliminates static and cross-talk and allows for services such as caller ID and message waiting indicators on wireless phones.
Motorola said the service will be offered in the two areas in early 1997.

Bell Atlantic NYNEX Mobile was formed in July through the combination of Bell Atlantic Corp.'s and NYNEX Corp.'s cellular operations. The Bedminster, N.J.-based company is the nation's second-largest wireless service provider and the largest on the East Coast.
Motorola's stock rose 50 cents to $50.875 on the New York Stock Exchange, where it was among the most active issues at midday.
